_comment: Who may use which model, which document labels, and which tools. Roles are Keycloak realm roles. Unknown labels are refused. Tools get a token exchanged at Keycloak that is only valid for that tool (audience) and scope. Agents acting for a user (token with "act") may use only the models listed for them, and only within what the user may use. Edit and save: the gateway reloads this file on the next request.
